hook_text: Mandela gave 67 years of his life to serving others. Can you give 67 minutes?
clip_script: Mandela Day, the 18th of July, eMalahleni. A Grade 4 class picks up litter around the school, plants spekboom, packs food parcels for an old age home and reads to the Grade R learners. Sixty-seven minutes, for the sixty-seven years Mandela spent serving his people. You do not need to be famous to follow a good leader. Listen. Help. Work as a team. Be brave. Keep your promises. Leadership starts with you.
visual_style: Whiteboard clock counting down from 67 minutes while little figures pick up litter, plant a tree, carry boxes and read a book.
mood: Bright, busy and proud, like a community day.
pacing: The clock starts, quick scenes of helping, then the qualities written one by one.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and plan your own 67 minutes of helping someone.
